title: Sports Equipment Borrow & Return Tracker
problem: Volleyballs and cricket bats go missing every evening because students borrow them without writing their names in the paper register.
idea: A sports room helper. Show the item to the camera, type your name, and it is logged. At the end of the day it shows what is still missing. Try it below.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: What item is shown to the camera?
widgets.intro: In my real project, Teachable Machine recognises the item. Tap what the camera sees.
widgets.question: A student shows:

options.label: Volleyball
options.result: Volleyball recognised. Type your name to borrow it. Return by 6:30 PM.
options.te: వాలీబాల్. తీసుకోవడానికి మీ పేరు టైప్ చేయండి. సాయంత్రం 6:30కి తిరిగి ఇవ్వండి.

options.label: Cricket bat
options.result: Cricket bat recognised. Type your name to borrow it. Return by 6:30 PM.
options.te: క్రికెట్ బ్యాట్. మీ పేరు టైప్ చేయండి. 6:30కి తిరిగి ఇవ్వండి.

options.label: Football
options.result: Football recognised. Type your name to borrow it. Return by 6:30 PM.
options.te: ఫుట్‌బాల్. మీ పేరు టైప్ చేయండి. 6:30కి తిరిగి ఇవ్వండి.

options.label: Unknown item
options.result: I don't know this item. Please ask the PET sir to write it in the register.
options.te: ఈ వస్తువు నాకు తెలియదు. PET సార్‌ని రిజిస్టర్‌లో రాయమనండి.

widgets.heading: 🧮 End-of-day count
widgets.intro: Enter today's numbers to see what is missing.
widgets.formula: if (typeof given !== 'number' || typeof back !== 'number' || typeof price !== 'number') return null; if (given < 0 || back < 0 || back > given) return null; var missing = given - back; var loss = missing * price; var msg = missing === 0 ? 'All items are back. Great team! 🏆' : 'Check the register and call the students who still have them.'; return {missing: missing, loss: loss, msg: msg, level: missing === 0 ? 'good' : 'bad'};

items.title: Name first
items.text: No name, no ball. Every item is logged before it leaves.

items.title: Return on time
items.text: Return everything before the evening bell.

items.title: Report damage
items.text: If something breaks, tell the PET teacher honestly.
items.te: ఏదైనా పాడైతే PET టీచర్‌కి నిజాయితీగా చెప్పండి.

how: In Teachable Machine, make classes for Volleyball, Cricket bat, Football and Nothing. Take about 40 photos of each.
Train, Export and copy the model link into PictoBlox (Scratch blocks with the Machine Learning extension).
When an item is seen, 'ask' the student's name and add 'name – item – time' to a list called 'Borrowed'.
When the item comes back, show it again and remove that line from the list.
At 6:30 PM, show the 'Borrowed' list on screen: these items are still missing.
Ask Gemini to write polite reminder messages for late returns.
prompt: I am a Class 8 sports captain. Write 3 polite reminder messages in English and Telugu for students who have not returned the volleyball or cricket bat, and 4 simple rules for our sports room.
